podcast.body: Many of Chumbawamba's initial releases were distributed solely on cassette tapes and began appearing on the UK indie charts a few years after the band's formation, indicating their origins in the independent music scene. "After a few years, their releases, many of which were cassette only, started appearing on the UK indie charts."
